content.text:
I've submitted the campaign. The best result is index 8 (Ca 0.22, Fe 0.66, Mn 0.12), but it only reached 1e-8 A, which is close to nothing. I most likely haven't found the library's best composition.

The budget allowed 3 photocurrent measurements (I used all of them) and 5 XRD scans (I used 3):

| Index | Ca / Fe / Mn | Photocurrent (A) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.14 / 0.70 / 0.16 | ~0 |
| **8** | **0.22 / 0.66 / 0.12** | **1e-8** |
| 46 | 0.50 / 0.35 / 0.16 | −7e-8 |

- **Index 46:** the Ca-rich point gave a negative current, meaning no photoanode response.
- **XRD (indices 13, 14, 104):** didn't help. All three showed the same main peak pattern, which is probably from the substrate or a phase common to the whole library. Index 13 (Mn-rich) had a few extra weak peaks.
- **Not tested:** the Mn-rich region (Mn above 0.5) and the middle of the composition space. I left out the Mn-rich side because manganese oxides are usually poor photoanodes, not because anything I measured ruled it out.

With three measurements spread across a 183-composition library, a result this close to zero means I didn't find a good region.
